name: Hayasaka Yayoi
source:
She is the head of the second year class. She is also in charge of life guidance and is very strict about discipline.
She thinks that the protagonist is an unfit person for the school and checks his every action, nagging and lecturing him every time she sees him.
Her influence puts the protagonist in a difficult situation.

[Translated from [url=http://www.bishop.gr.jp/products/hkgie/character.html]offical character page[/url]]
